title: #achristmasstory
transcript: We did it. Opening night went really, really, really well. I'm so proud of everyone, including Everett, who plays Ralphie. It was his first show ever and he did so great. Only one missed step, and this is only live theater can this happen, is at the end of Act 1, um, Ralphie is having a nightmare. He's not gonna get his Red Ryder BB gun. And we're all like singing this like song and attacking him as zombies at the end. And at the end we're all like posing as zombies and like, you know, attacking him. And the blackout didn't happen. The lighting board glitched and we just stood there like, and, um, an uncomfortable silence and the audience was like, is there more? And then the God Mike said, actors, please leave. Please leave the stage. Gotta love live theater. But we did it. We did it. We did it.
